description: Create a hosted verification session. Returns a link (url) to send to the person, who opens it on their own phone, photographs their voter ID, and records a short video. Billed to the connected account when created (see get_account) and refunded if it expires unfinished. The result is not stored: read it with ine_session_get within 15 minutes of the person finishing. Only create one when the user asks to verify someone. Details: read_doc "ine/endpoints/ine-sessions".

allow_desktop.description: Let the hosted page also run with a computer's webcam. By default it only runs on a phone or tablet; a computer is shown the link's QR code to continue on a phone.

expires_in.description: Seconds the link works for: 60 to 259200 (three days).

locale.description: Language of the hosted page. `es` is read as `es_MX`.

redirect_url.description: Where the closing screen's Continue button takes the person; `session_id` is added to its query string. http or https.

reference.description: Your own label for the session, up to 200 bytes (an order or user id). It comes back on the session. Do not put personal data in it.

verify.description: Also ask INE about the credential, as `/ine/verify` does. +10 credits.

verify_curp.description: Also ask RENAPO about the card's CURP, as `/curp/lookup` does. +5 credits.

name: ine_session_create
title: Create a hosted verification session
